response.overview: Growing up in poverty while facing relentless bullying and an undiagnosed neurodivergence, Anthony, an Omaha, NE resident, struggled to find where he belonged. Everything changed when he discovered freestyle scooter riding. What began as an escape became a source of confidence, community, and purpose. Scooter Boy is an inspiring documentary about resilience, acceptance, and the transformative power of finding a place and people that believe in you.
